Job Title: Senior Backend Engineer
Company: Example Software Labs (synthetic test posting)

About the role
You will design and build scalable APIs and data pipelines for our analytics platform.

Requirements
5+ years of experience in backend development.
Strong in Python and Go, with production experience in PostgreSQL and Redis.
Must have hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes and AWS.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent.
Experience designing REST APIs and microservices.

Nice to have
Experience with Kafka, Terraform and GraphQL.
AWS Certified Solutions Architect is a plus.

Responsibilities
Design and implement microservices and REST APIs.
Own CI/CD pipelines and observability for backend services.
Mentor junior engineers and review code.
